strategy: security-first canary rollout, approval per edit, no commits

constraints.editAuthority: none by default - every edit requires explicit user approval in conversation
constraints.verification: tsc --noEmit + next build after each approved batch (no test suite exists in repo)

waves.name: Critical privilege escalation
waves.approach: New migration 003_admin_flag_hardening.sql: replace handle_new_user so is_platform_admin is never sourced from raw_user_meta_data (always false on self-signup; platform admins granted via ADMIN_EMAILS env or manual SQL). Optionally keep auth.ts ADMIN_EMAILS path as recovery channel. Also scrub any existing self-granted admin rows.
waves.risk: low - signup flow untouched for normal users

waves.name: Tenant isolation
waves.approach: H2: change getCards org filter to strict equality (drop || !c.location_id) and add explicit admin-only listing for blanks (used by wave 3). H19: drop 'Public read for locations' policy; narrow cards public SELECT to the columns/path actually needed (nothing - service role bypasses RLS) and drop 'Public insert for interactions' (recordInteraction uses admin client). Verify redirects still work (service role bypasses RLS - yes).
waves.risk: medium - touches RLS; requires careful check that no anon path reads these tables
waves.rollback: restore prior policies in same migration style

waves.name: Operator admin workflow
waves.approach: New admin-only GET /api/admin/inventory returning getAllInventoryCards() + all locations (org name labeled). Rewire admin cards page to it; assign modal lists all locations with org labels. Larger refactor per referee.

waves.name: Analytics correctness
waves.approach: H4: accumulate yesterday (add yesterday window to stats or compute from interactions). H5: align param name (send locationId). H6: read searchParams filter in cards page.

waves.name: Input validation + error hygiene
waves.approach: Shared helpers: validateInventoryCode (regex ^RT-[0-9]{6}$ or general safe charset, reject RT- prefix for non-platform callers), validatePlacement (enum), sanitizeApiError(err) -> generic message + Sentry.captureException. Assign route: verify location exists first.

waves.name: Redirect/URL hardening
waves.approach: H7: sanitize redirectTo (must start with '/' and not '//'). H12: derive appUrl from headers() host + protocol with NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL override; remove hardcoded reviewtap.id fallback.

waves.name: Config fail-closed + small UX fixes
waves.approach: H13: throw at client creation when SERVICE_ROLE_KEY missing in production. H16: window.print(). H20: render error message for unauthorized_admin_access or hide admin link for non-admins (sidebar needs user prop - dashboard layout already has context).

waves.name: Manual-review decisions (product/infra)
waves.approach: Present options to user: rate limiting mechanism choice (Supabase auth config vs middleware), test-flag gating, getCards scalability refactor, dead-code removal vs wiring, batch-generate conflict retry. Not auto-planned.
